name: TexasPete
summary: Holds the record: 6:50.000 on SRC, recorded 10/14 on routes that are now dead (Keep skip, the rocks to Kuldra). He contributed zoop routing (surge off ledges), the Stronghold jump and the melee heart. His commentary is mostly hype; the useful material is in his replies and SRC comments. His YouTube channel is otherwise pitbike racing.

insights.text: Surge off the edge of stuff. Sometimes it works better than others.

insights.text: You’re my hero. What a time saver. A little tricky to get it first try everytime but worth it! I hadn’t seen other people do it on their runs but I did see one must have been you. Took me a long time to put it all together

insights.text: Good stuff I found optimal spots to skip stages but never thought about the boss fight. 10/10. Will never be able to beat this time now after the patch!
I don't understand why the gate for you 4 minutes in is closed. always open for me even on full reset

This run is a mix of some of my original strats and some borrowed. I was able to pull off a sub 9 run while staying in the map and completing the Cataclysm Keep puzzle before I saw some videos of the skip recently. 

I accidently stopped the clock less than a second short. Total time was roughly 7.40.84

If you have tried this, you know there is so many places that one small mistake will blow the run. Very happy to pull this near perfect run out. There is room for improvement but it will take many attempts to replicate. 

We will see how it evolves if some new strats come into play. Cheers
Great run! Where did you get the livesplit template or did you make it?

recordings.summary: Live-commentary upload of the 6:50 SRC run (m74jw34m). The auto-transcript is all reactions ("Where all runs go to die" at 1:57, the Fragments zoop; "Here at the needle" at 4:27). It has no technical explanation. Segments that are now dead: the Keep OOB skip and the windstep rocks to Kuldra (1.0.1.2: "the rock a phantom").

This run is a mix of some of my original strats and some borrowed. I was able to pull off a sub 9 run while staying in the map and completing the Cataclysm Keep puzzle before I saw some videos of the skip recently. 

I accidently stopped the clock less than a second short. Total time was roughly 7.40.84

If you have tried this, you know there is so many places that one small mistake will blow the run. Very happy to pull this near perfect run out. There is room for improvement but it will take many attempts to replicate. 

We will see how it evolves if some new strats come into play. Cheers
